tools.name: search_products
tools.when_to_use: Find products by a free-text query over name, brand, articul and codes (all query tokens must match).
tools.when_not_to_use: You have an exact code/articul/GTIN (use search_by_code/articul/gtin), or you need prices (use the offer service).

tools.name: search_by_code
tools.when_to_use: Look up products by an exact supplier product code or external id.
tools.when_not_to_use: You only have a fuzzy description (use search_products).

tools.name: search_by_articul
tools.when_to_use: Look up products by an exact supplier articul.
tools.when_not_to_use: You only have a fuzzy description (use search_products).

tools.name: search_by_gtin
tools.when_to_use: Look up products by a GTIN/EAN/UPC barcode (normalized to GTIN-14 before matching).
tools.when_not_to_use: You only have a fuzzy description (use search_products).
